title: Entropy Concentration and Universal Typicality for Almost i.i.d. Quantum Sources
summary: We establish two concentration principles for almost i.i.d. quantum sources under the weakly almost i.i.d. condition, the broadest condition in the established hierarchy of almost i.i.d. sources. Our results therefore apply also to Wasserstein- and Mazzola-Sutter-Renner almost i.i.d. sources. Weakly almost i.i.d. sources are sequences of multipartite states whose fixed-size marginals converge, on average, to tensor powers of a reference state, while allowing arbitrary global correlations and entanglement.
